correctness.rationale: The 2x2 determinant -1 makes A=(0,1;1,2) a permutation on every (Z/2^k)^2. Smith exponents of A-I and A²-I are (0,1) and (1,1), giving fixed counts 2 and 4. At j=2, A^4-I=4 C2 where C2=(1,3;3,7), with v2(gcd entries)=0 and v2(det C2)=1. Squaring recurrence A^(2^j)=I+2^j C_j gives C_(j+1)=C_j(I+2^(j-1)C_j); second factor is 2-adically invertible for j>=2, hence Smith exponents of C_j remain (0,1), so of A^(2^j)-I are (j,j+1) for all j. The congruence kernel formula 2^(min(k,e1)+min(k,e2)) gives every F_j(k). Since A^(2^k) is identity mod2^k, all orbit lengths are powers of two; c_j=(F_j-F_(j-1))/2^j yields claimed complete multiplicities and total N_k=2^(k+1)-2 k>=2, with N1=3 and boundary k2 checked. Independently enumerated every state k=1..9 (262144 states at k9), exactly matching c_0..c_k, N9=1022. Finite evidence corroborates all-k Smith-lifting proof.

originality.rationale: Deveci–Karaduman's full-text Theorem 2.2 computes the standard Pell-seed period 2^k, and Theorems 2.3–2.6 discuss recurrence periods and lifting in groups; these do not tabulate cycles of every initial pair. Deveci–Akdeniz–Karaduman 2015 studies higher-order generalized Pell p-sequences and periods in finite groups, with different recurrence and generating-seed hypotheses; Brent 1994 assumes mod-2 primitive/irreducible characteristic polynomial, whereas Pell characteristic (x+1)^2 mod2 violates it. The full state orbit formula is derived here by exact 2-adic Smith spectra; unindexed coverage remains possible.
residual_risks: A specialist classification of all-seed modular linear recurrences via invariant factors might already imply this exact case without citing Pell in its title.
Source PDFs with only selected pages inspected cannot support a global NOT_COVERING claim.

value.rationale: The orbit decomposition of a canonical Pell recurrence state map on the full modular phase space is a natural dynamical/arithmetic invariant, finer than the period of the standard Pell seed. Explicit multiplicities of every cycle length for all 2-power moduli provide exact benchmark data for modular recurrence dynamics and seed sampling, not an arbitrary digit-window count.
